svg.text: The four wires, as a schematic
The same four wires for every module: power, ground, data, clock. This is the whole circuit, in either kit.
Kit A: four breadboard columns. Kit B: four wires, one module
CSB, SDO: leave open (6-pin boards only)
answers at 0x76 or 0x77. chip ID 0x60 = BME280, 0x58 = BMP280
read the silkscreen: VCC and GND order varies by vendor
DS3231 real time clock (optional, Kit A only)
keeps time on a coin cell when the board is off
answers at 0x68. 0x57 is the EEPROM on the same module
